issues.issue: Business-type spending is printed by cost type (Cost of power, Personnel services, Operating expenses, Supplies, Depreciation). The 2026-10-28 cost-type rule gives each such line a cost-type category plus function 'utilities'. 'Operating expenses' was left as function category 'utilities' with no function field. It is a generic cost type (probably 'other'). Amount is correct.

Not relabelled 'Capital Outlay: <function>' per the 2026-10-26 rule. The matching p14 detail line was relabelled 'Capital Outlay: Culture and Recreation'. Street Fund detail[59] 'Capital outlay' 50,000 (p11) is also not relabelled. Amounts are correct.
